entities.summary: Mittal Patel is an Indian social and environmental activist, known for her work with marginalized and nomadic communities in Gujarat. She is the founder of Vicharta Samuday Samarthan Manch (VSSM), an organization working on social justice, education, livelihood support, environmental sustainability, and community development.
